description: A valid allowed-input manifest. The Phase 0 retry validator MUST accept this and reject manifests whose allowed-input hash is missing, mismatched, or whose input paths do not resolve.

allowed_inputs_record.description: Declares the exact input paths the Phase 0 retry gate may consume and their SHA-256 hashes. The hash in inputs_manifest_hash below MUST match the live hash of this file; any input whose declared sha256 does not match its live bytes is rejected.

note: Green phase: every placeholder sha256 has been replaced with the live SHA-256 of the referenced file and inputs_manifest_hash is computed as the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this record with inputs_manifest_hash removed.
